items.statement: The correctly identified m-NH2 molecule yields a reproducible S0-to-S1 charge-transfer D-index in water, supported by the optimized ground-state geometry, explicit S1 identity and hole-electron spatial analysis. Evaluate the specified single-system descriptor, not a new m-versus-p ordering.
